paragraphs: A son of Kimchit and a High Priest. In Yoma 47a
they say: once Yishmael ben Kimchit, the High Priest, became ritually impure. His brother Yeshevav entered and served in his place, and their mother saw two High Priests in one day.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Their mother is said to have seen two of her sons serve as High Priest in a single day.

Yoma 47a names Yeshevav as the brother who served in Yishmael ben Kimchit’s place after the reported impurity, and says their mother saw two high priests in one day. The adjacent account names a different brother, Yosef; it is not merged into this notice.
